bull.b: The clinical results indicate meaningful and durable activity in heavily pretreated patients, including a strong response signal in the BTKi-exposed subgroup. If confirmed, this efficacy could support differentiation for iopofosine and provide a durable foundation for regulatory and commercial progress.

A defined confirmatory trial and accelerated-approval roadmap give the lead program a clearer path toward commercialization than an early discovery-stage asset. Breakthrough Designation and a targeted FDA review may help concentrate development resources and shorten the route to a potential approval.

Low debt reduces fixed financial obligations while the rebuilt equity base and higher cash balance provide greater flexibility to advance clinical programs. This stronger capital position can support trial initiation and near-term execution without relying primarily on additional borrowing.

bear.b: The absence of product revenue means the business has not yet demonstrated commercial demand or operating leverage. Persistent losses leave future value dependent on clinical and regulatory success, while the lack of recurring revenue limits internal funding capacity and increases execution sensitivity.

Ongoing negative operating and free cash flow requires continued access to external capital until a product reaches the market. Although burn improved from 2024, sustained cash consumption can constrain development choices, increase financing dependence, and pressure the company if milestones take longer.

A substantial portion of expected financing depends on future execution and milestone achievement, so available capital may be less than the headline amount. The large warrant package also creates potential dilution, which can reduce existing holders’ ownership as development milestones are reached.
